about_the_game:
Read manga, comics, magazines and photos from your harddrive in VR.

  • Zoomable and grabbable pages

  • Intuitive controls designed for manga/comics and small text

    • Close reading mode

    • Quick focus

    • Page tilting

  • Great resolution & image compression

  • Supported files in early access: pdf, cbz, zip, jpg, jpeg, png

  • No advertising or other hidden costs

  • No online store, you have to have the content in your PC

  • Low system requirements. Tested on an older laptop with an AMD Ryzen 5 3550H, 8GB RAM, and an Nvidia GTX 1050, using a Meta Quest 2 via Steam Link.

Handling the pages and reading in VR works a little differently than in real life. Here are two ways I've found it to be better and more enjoyable in VR than in real life.

FULL PAGE MODE

  • Focus the page

  • Zoom so you see the whole page at once

  • Turn tilting toggle on from book settings

  • Press left/right to turn the whole page normally and use Focus when necessary

CLOSE READING MODE

  • Turn tilting off from book settings

  • Use focus to center the page

  • Pressing up/down keeps the page in close, and pulls it from up to down

Day 1 update v0.8.3: Analog stick deadzone slider, and early keyboard support. More info in Community Hub (button on upper side of the Steam page).

2025.9.29 Update v0.8.5: Update for VR controller's deadzone

2025.10.8: Quick security patch fix.

name: VR-Reader

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel i3-6100/AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 970/AMD Radeon R9
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 300 MB available space
  • VR Support: OpenXR supported headsets and OpenXR Toolkit supported controllers: Meta Quest 1, Meta Quest 2, Meta Quest 3, Meta Quest Pro, HTC Vive, Valve Index, Oculus Rift, WMR headsets
  • Additional Notes: Works in AMD Ryzen 5 3550H, 8GB, Nvidia 1050 laptop with Meta Quest 2 via Steam Link
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10, Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel i5-4590/AMD Ryzen 5 1500X
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060/AMD Radeon RX 480
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 300 MB available space
  • VR Support: OpenXR supported headsets and OpenXR Toolkit supported controllers: Meta Quest 1, Meta Quest 2, Meta Quest 3, Meta Quest Pro, HTC Vive, Valve Index, Oculus Rift, WMR headsets
